title: Compute the underlying module of a persistence exterior square

source.citation: Leon Lampret, Tensor, Symmetric, Exterior, and Other Powers of Persistence Modules, arXiv:1503.08266

translation.notes: The paper's barcode module is presented as R plus R/(t^3), R/(t^2), and R/(t), with R=Q[t]. Noether constructs its exterior square and certified annihilator and Fitting ideals identify the underlying module as R/(t^3), two copies of R/(t^2), and three copies of R/(t). Persistence intervals and their grading interpretation are not inferred by this case.
